neighbours.label: the word 'vocational' (vocational training, school or college), as against other kinds of education
fire: Young people who choose vocational training often find work quickly.
The city opened a new vocational centre for mechanics and cooks.
After ninth grade he transferred to a vocational high school.
Funding for vocational programs was cut by the province.
She teaches at a vocational college outside Berlin.
Many adults return to vocational courses after losing a job.
Apprentices combine work with vocational classes twice a week.
The ministry's Vocational & Technical division reviews each curriculum.
quiet: Young people who choose graduate school often find work slowly.
The city opened a new sports centre for swimmers and runners.
After ninth grade he transferred to a private high school.
Funding for music programs was cut by the province.
She teaches at a liberal arts college outside Berlin.
Many adults return to evening yoga courses after losing a job.
Retirees combine travel with art classes twice a week.
The ministry's Finance & Budget division reviews each curriculum.

notes: Output of this pole promotes ' vocational', ' career', ' technical'. The card also shows ' and', ' in', ' &' in education text, reading 0.1-0.5 in the probe, so the word is unlikely to cover the whole pole. Synonyms read low (trade school 0.15, apprenticeship 0.11, technical 0.33), so the label stays at the word.
